key_insight: Homomorphic Advantage Operator (HAO) stabilizes fully homomorphic encrypted reinforcement learning by centering temporal-difference targets to suppress Bellman drift without increasing multiplicative depth.
engineering_relevance: HAO makes privacy-preserving cloud RL more practical by keeping encrypted activations inside the safe polynomial range while avoiding costly bootstrapping.
method: Apply a zero-mean centering projection to TD targets to remove the uniform value baseline.
Preserve action rankings while reducing recursive approximation error under CKKS/FHE.
Test across tabular MDP, encrypted CartPole, and a 20-node logistics routing benchmark.
evidence_signal: Across the reported evaluations, HAO achieved 0% boundary breaches across seeds, improved tabular policy accuracy by 18.0 percentage points, and remained stable under added DP-SGD-style Gaussian noise.
watch_item: Results depend on careful tuning of polynomial approximation bounds and cryptographic parameters, so deployment may still require environment-specific calibration.
paper_title: Homomorphic Advantage Operator: Stabilizing Reinforcement Learning Under Fully Homomorphic Encryption Constraints
